items.text: Rounds 1 and 2 contain 7 unanswered decisions. The plan cannot progress until at least round-001 decisions d1 (what is this?) and d2 (target users) are answered. Please review and answer those first — all other decisions depend on them.

items.context: This item is priority 3 (medium). Understanding urgency helps determine whether to invest in a full scenario or a quick prototype. If this is exploratory, a spike/proof-of-concept may be more appropriate than a full implementation plan.

options.label: Full scenario — production quality
options.rationale: Invest in a complete scenario with proper tests, docs, and service.json. Appropriate if this will be a long-lived capability.

options.label: Spike / proof-of-concept first
options.rationale: Build a minimal prototype to validate the idea before committing to a full scenario. Lower risk, faster feedback.

options.label: Low priority — park for later
options.rationale: Capture the decisions made so far but don't invest implementation effort yet. Revisit when higher-priority work is done.

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe your timeline expectations in the freeform field.

items.context: The agent-manager already has an investigation scoring system (internal/orchestration/investigation.go) that rates proposed fixes on a cost (1-5) scale representing effort/risk to implement. If 'Effort Test' is about effort estimation, it may overlap with or extend this existing capability rather than being entirely new.

options.label: Extends agent-manager's cost scoring
options.rationale: Build on the existing investigation.go cost dimension. Add richer effort modeling (time, tokens, complexity) as a new module within agent-manager.

options.label: Standalone — no relation to agent-manager
options.rationale: This is a separate concept unrelated to agent-manager's investigation scoring. Build from scratch.

options.label: Integrates with swarm-manager backlog
options.rationale: Effort estimation as a swarm-manager feature — attaches estimates to backlog items for prioritization and scheduling.

options.label: Not applicable
options.rationale: Select if this item is a placeholder or test.

items.text: Ecosystem context: The agent-manager's investigation.go already scores proposed fixes on cost (1-5 effort/risk). The swarm-manager tracks backlog items with priority metadata. If this idea is about effort estimation, there are natural integration points in both scenarios.

plan_updates: No plan.md changes — all 13 sections remain TBD. Blocked on round-001 decisions (especially d1: what is 'Effort Test'?). Round 3 adds timeline/priority intent and ecosystem integration decisions.
